toilets.title: 罗马公共厕所
toilets.blurb: 大家坐成一排聊天，海绵棒传着走。古罗马的社交，从蹲坑开始。
toilets.blurbEn: A social bench of holes. Romans chatted here; a shared sponge stick did the rounds.

toilets.title: 奥斯蒂亚长廊厕
toilets.blurb: 港口城市的大理石长厕，流水在脚下唱歌。
toilets.blurbEn: A marble latrine hall by the port, with a little river singing under the seats.

toilets.title: 印度河古厕
toilets.blurb: 四千年前就有砖砌下水道。蹲下去，也是文明。
toilets.blurbEn: Brick drains from four millennia ago. Sitting down can still be civilization.

toilets.title: 沙海旱坑
toilets.blurb: 风大、沙多、星星近。蹲着看银河，也算豪华包厢。
toilets.blurbEn: Wind, sand, and a front-row seat to the Milky Way.

toilets.title: 长安宫厕
toilets.blurb: 唐朝宫里也要方便。木台、香囊、太监在帘外假装听不见。
toilets.blurbEn: Even Tang palaces needed a privy: wood, incense, and a eunuch pretending not to hear.

toilets.title: 紫禁城蹲坑
toilets.blurb: 朱红柱旁的宫厕。皇帝也得蹲，只是金砖比较亮。
toilets.blurbEn: Even an emperor squats. The bricks are just shinier.

toilets.title: 四合院旱厕
toilets.blurb: 月亮门后头那一间。冬天冷，夏天有蝉，邻居都认识你的脚步。
toilets.blurbEn: The little room past the moon gate. Winter bites; summer cicadas know your footsteps.

toilets.title: 胡同公厕
toilets.blurb: 老北京的社交中心之一。报纸、闲话、蹲姿，三位一体。
toilets.blurbEn: Old Beijing's other salon: newspaper, gossip, and a practiced squat.

toilets.title: 凡尔赛便椅
toilets.blurb: 镶金的椅子，其实就是豪华移动马桶。宫廷礼仪：假装没看见。
toilets.blurbEn: A gilded chair that is secretly a loo. Court etiquette: pretend you saw nothing.

toilets.title: 维多利亚高水箱
toilets.blurb: 拉一根链条，水从天花板砸下来。蒸汽时代的交响乐。
toilets.blurbEn: Yank the chain; a waterfall starts at the ceiling. Steam-age percussion.

toilets.title: 酒馆长槽
toilets.blurb: 一排绅士对着瓷砖沉思人生。啤酒进，智慧出。
toilets.blurbEn: A row of gentlemen contemplating tiles. Beer in, philosophy out.

toilets.title: 日本智洁马桶
toilets.blurb: 盖子自己抬，水自己暖，还有烘干小风。科技，为了尊严。
toilets.blurbEn: The lid lifts, the water is warm, and a tiny breeze dries you. Dignity, automated.

toilets.title: 温泉日式蹲厕
toilets.blurb: 洗完澡再蹲一下。蒸汽、木格、拖鞋分左右。
toilets.blurbEn: A squat after the bath. Steam, wood lattice, and slippers that know left from right.

toilets.title: 大阪街角小便斗
toilets.blurb: 霓虹下面的小瓷斗。城市允许你暂停三十秒。
toilets.blurbEn: A porcelain pause under neon. The city grants you thirty seconds.

toilets.title: 车站瓷斗
toilets.blurb: 赶车的人最诚实。三十秒，世界继续转。
toilets.blurbEn: People catching trains are honest. Thirty seconds, then the world resumes.

toilets.title: 高铁真空马桶
toilets.blurb: 谁osh 一声，东西去了远方。请在停车时再冲。
toilets.blurbEn: A whoosh, and it goes somewhere far. Please wait until the train stops.

toilets.title: 客机真空马桶
toilets.blurb: 云上的小房间。冲水像台风，耳膜会鼓掌。
toilets.blurbEn: A tiny room in the clouds. The flush is a typhoon; your eardrums applaud.

toilets.title: 机场无障碍坐便
toilets.blurb: 扶手、空间、门往外开。体面，是给所有人的。
toilets.blurbEn: Rails, space, and a door that opens out. Dignity is for everyone.

toilets.title: 博物馆无障碍厕
toilets.blurb: 看完文物，也要方便地当回当代人。
toilets.blurbEn: After the relics, a room that treats you like a contemporary person.

toilets.title: 加长家用坐便
toilets.blurb: 加长圈，是对高个子的温柔。手机支架另说。
toilets.blurbEn: An elongated bowl is kindness to long legs. Phone shelf sold separately.

toilets.title: 儿童小坐便
toilets.blurb: 小圈圈，大胜利。贴纸奖励，比冲水声还响。
toilets.blurbEn: A tiny ring and a huge win. Stickers louder than the flush.

toilets.title: 小学校蹲位
toilets.blurb: 课间冲刺。门板很矮，勇气要很高。
toilets.blurbEn: Recess sprint. The door is short; courage must be tall.

toilets.title: 音乐节移动厕
toilets.blurb: 蓝房子，热浪，友情考验。带洗手液的人是英雄。
toilets.blurbEn: A blue box, a heat wave, a friendship test. Hand gel makes you a hero.

toilets.title: 工地移动厕
toilets.blurb: 安全帽与蓝房子。劳动最光荣，冲水请温柔。
toilets.blurbEn: Hard hats and a blue cabin. Work is glorious; flush gently.

toilets.title: 酒店金坐便
toilets.blurb: 香薰、音乐、一尘不染。你配得上这段小假期。
toilets.blurbEn: Scent, music, spotless porcelain. You deserve this tiny holiday.

toilets.title: 实验室洁净厕
toilets.blurb: 白到发光。出来还要洗手到肘。科学，从门把手开始。
toilets.blurbEn: White enough to glow. Wash to the elbows. Science starts at the door handle.

toilets.title: 空间站马桶
toilets.blurb: 真空、脚镫、对准教程。在地球上，重力是免费的。
toilets.blurbEn: Vacuum, foot straps, and a targeting tutorial. On Earth, gravity is free.

toilets.title: 飞船胶囊厕
toilets.blurb: 更小、更吵、更重要。宇航员的秘密训练课。
toilets.blurbEn: Smaller, louder, more important. The secret training module.
